title: Glowing lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M35 22 Q50 8 65 22' fill='none' stroke='#b56a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='32' y='20' width='36' height='7' rx='3' fill='#d4832f'/>
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='32' height='3' rx='2' fill='#f0b45c'/>
  <!-- glass body outer frame -->
  <rect x='30' y='27' width='40' height='46' rx='6' fill='#ffe89a'/>
  <!-- inner glow layers -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='34' height='40' rx='4' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#fff6c9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- flame -->
  <path d='M50 40 Q55 47 50 55 Q45 47 50 40 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <path d='M50 44 Q53 49 50 53 Q47 49 50 44 Z' fill='#ffdf70'/>
  <!-- side glass highlight -->
  <rect x='32' y='30' width='4' height='38' rx='2' fill='#fff1b8' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='32' y='73' width='36' height='7' rx='3' fill='#d4832f'/>
  <rect x='34' y='75' width='32' height='3' rx='2' fill='#f0b45c'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='36' y='80' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b56a2a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='80' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b56a2a'/>
  <!-- warm sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='2' fill='#fff6c9'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#fff6c9'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#fff6c9'/>
</svg>
